item.title: The Cure Win First-Ever Grammy Awards
item.description: A special shoutout to The Cure for winning their first Grammy Awards on Sunday. They won for Best Alternative Performance (“Alone”) and Best Alternative Album (Songs of a Lost World).

item.title: Gary Cioni Talks Producing on New Podcast
item.description: Gary Cioni (Crime In Stereo, NEKS, Daytrader) joined Emo Kids Anonymous to talk about Long Island Emo and Hardcore, his transition from artist to producer, and working with bands like Hot Mulligan and other modern emo bands.
